postTitle: Stop Recomputing: How useMemo Keeps Your React UI Fast
postContent:
Memoize the result of a pure calculation between renders.
It avoids expensive recalculations when dependencies haven’t changed.
It’s a cache for a value, not a UI component.
Put it at the top level of a component to cache derived data.
Example scenario: filtering a long list.
The common pattern: const visibleTodos = useMemo(() => filterTodos(todos, tab), [todos, tab]);
Use it for expensive work only. It won’t speed up every render by itself.

tehnicalChallange.title: Memoize a filtered list with useMemo
tehnicalChallange.description: Build a component that receives a list of items and a filter (tab). Use useMemo to compute the filtered list so it only recalculates when the list or tab changes.
